# Preface {.unnumbered}

This manual provides an end-user oriented path through C5-DEC workflows.

The content is reorganized from docs/manual to improve discoverability while keeping the same functional scope.

## Start here

1. Use [Reader guide](chapters/01-reader-guide.qmd) for navigation strategy.
2. Use [Installation and workspace setup](chapters/02-installation.qmd) when preparing or repairing an environment.
3. Use [Quick start and interfaces](chapters/03-quick-start.qmd) for launch paths.
4. Use [Module guides](chapters/04-module-guides.qmd) for feature workflows.
5. Use [Troubleshooting](chapters/05-troubleshooting.qmd) to resolve common failures.
6. Use [Command reference](chapters/06-command-reference.qmd) for copy/paste command lookup.

## Scope

This report covers user-facing operation of C5-DEC modules and publishing workflows documented in the manual set.

It does not change product behavior or introduce new normative requirements.
